title: Stasis Bayou Wagon
description: A bearded man sits on a green plastic chair inside a red Radio Flyer wagon being pulled by a chain of small skeletons across a dirt path. A woman in a long black gothic dress stands beside him in front of a weathered green wooden building labeled STASIS with a heron perched on the roof and a purple hammock hanging from the porch.
